'''Katakurabe no Mikoto''' (片倉辺命) is a deity from the folk tradition of the {{ill|Suwa Region|ja|諏訪地方|lt=Suwa region}} in Nagano Prefecture, associated with the {{ill|Suwa Shrine|ja|諏訪信仰|lt=Suwa faith}}.

[[File:Suwa-taisha Kamisha Maemiya - Wakamiko-sha (若御子社).jpg|thumb|250px|Wakamiko-sha at Suwa Taisha Kamisha Maemiya]]

== Overview ==
Katakurabe no Mikoto is also written as '''片倉辺神''' or '''片倉辺尊'''. A related deity with a similar name, '''Mikurabe no Mikoto''' (御倉辺命), is mentioned, though it is unclear if they are the same deity.

Katakurabe no Mikoto is considered a child of {{ill|Takeminakata|en|Takeminakata|qid=Q9150391|qid=Q9150391|lt=Takeminakata}}, residing at the southern foot of Mount Moriya (片倉) and believed to be enshrined in the former {{ill|Nyukatakura Village|ja|入片倉村}} of the Saku District. The deity's burial site is said to be in the Saku District.{{Sfn|Nobukazu|1921|p=17}}

According to the genealogical record of the {{ill|Moriya clan|ja|守矢氏}}, written in the early Meiji period, Katakurabe no Mikoto's son, {{ill|Kodamahiko-no-Mikoto|ja|児玉彦命|lt=Kodamahiko-no-Mikoto}}, succeeded {{ill|Chikatsugami|ja|千鹿頭神}} as the fourth-generation leader. The ''Suwa Clan Genealogy: Continued Volume'' identifies Katakurabe no Mikoto as the ancestral deity of the {{ill|Katakura clan|en|Katakura clan|qid=Q15149847|lt=Katakura clan}}.

== Genealogy ==
[[File:Moriya Family Tree - 守矢氏系図.png|thumb|center|170px|Genealogy of the first five generations of the {{ill|Moriya clan|ja|守矢氏}}]]

Katakurabe no Mikoto is the child of {{ill|Takeminakata|en|Takeminakata|qid=Q9150391|qid=Q9150391|lt=Takeminakata}} and {{ill|Yasakatome|en|Yasakatome|qid=Q9150392|lt=Yasakatome no Kami}}. While the consort is unknown, Katakurabe no Mikoto is said to have three children: {{ill|Kodamahiko-no-Mikoto|ja|児玉彦命|lt=Kodamahiko-no-Mikoto}}, {{ill|Kamitsumitama no Kami|ja|上津御玉神}}, and {{ill|Shimotsumitama no Kami|ja|下津御玉神}}.{{Sfn|Nobukazu|1921|pp=17–18}}

Among them, Kodamahiko no Mikoto succeeded {{ill|Chikatsugami|ja|千鹿頭神}} in both religious and political roles, married {{ill|Mitsutamahime no Kami|ja|美都多麻比売神}}, daughter of {{ill|Moritatsugami|ja|守達神|qid=Q65260779}}, and fathered {{ill|Yakushigami|ja|八櫛神}}. For this reason, Kodamahiko no Mikoto is counted as the fourth generation in the genealogical records of the {{ill|Moriya clan|ja|守矢氏}}.
